summary: @ornikar/repo-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle hook runs setup.mjs, which is itself obfuscated with hex identifiers and string-dictionary lookups. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a single-line 727KB blob using a rotating string-array decoder (WV8StW) with a large encoded constants table; its filename and content bear no relation to the package's stated purpose of shipping shared commitlint / prettier / lint-staged configuration. Fetching an alternate interpreter at install time to execute a bundled obfuscated payload evades Node-focused lifecycle scanners and has no legitimate justification in a repo-config package. Installing this version auto-executes attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine via the preinstall hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
